name: Horabe Midori
source:
She is 28 years old and works at a flower shop called "Dandy Lion"  in a neighboring town. She is very attentive and knowledgeable about flowers, and is very good at choosing the right flowers for the right purpose.

Her devotion to flowers is also shown to the person she is interested in, but sometimes it becomes too much attention to detail, and in fact, she is a heavy woman physically, personality-wise, and sexually.

She is currently in a long-distance relationship with a boyfriend, but today at work, something unusual happened in their relationship... Her long-distance boyfriend called to break up with her, and she became extremely depressed.

[From [url=https://nijikaku2007.wixsite.com/kinosei]official website[/url]]
